name: xslop
description: Hides AI reply slop on X: browser extension, scoring server and site.

scripts.ci:install: npm ci --prefix server --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm ci --prefix extension --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm ci --prefix site --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build: npm --prefix extension run build && npm --prefix site run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix extension test && npm --prefix site test
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix extension run test:e2e && npm --prefix site run test:e2e
